name: LOADING TEST v2 - int3 at entry point. If game CRASHES on boot, our patched bytes ARE what's executing. If it boots normally, either the deploy isn't landing or something (anti-tamper?) is substituting/reverting code at runtime.
_note: va/expect verified directly against this exe's real bytes: AddressOfEntryPoint = 0x40b6e0, actual byte there = 55 (push ebp), NOT 8B as the prior version of this file claimed -- that was wrong and would always fail-safe/skip. Fixed.
